parameters.content:
## 🎬 Educational Reel — full pipeline

Storyboard (Gemini 2.5 Pro) -> B&W single-scene images (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) -> assembled video (JSON2Video) + voiceover (Gemini TTS).

Output: ONE clean summary message in Slack (Automation #, Title, Voiceover text + link, Images list, Video link). No more one-by-one image posts.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: topic = the parenting lesson; numScenes = number of images (30 ~= 1:30-2:00).

values.content:
=You are a world-class parenting content creator who has studied the highest-performing parenting short-videos. Write SHORT, punchy, DIRECT expert advice for an English-speaking parenting audience (US/UK/CA/AU). The narration is authoritative, practical advice spoken in SECOND PERSON ('you', 'your child') — it is NOT a personal memoir. Do NOT use first-person lines like 'when my children were small', 'what I do', or 'I learned'. (A warm grandmother voice will read it aloud, so the words just need to be clear, confident, relatable advice — plain English, no emojis, no hashtags.)

Topic: {{ $('Config').first().json.topic }} — IMPORTANT: if this is blank or says 'auto', CHOOSE a fresh, broadly-appealing, high-engagement parenting topic yourself. Cover the FULL breadth of parenting (newborns, babies, toddlers, school-age kids, tweens, teens; sleep, tantrums, discipline, screen time, emotional intelligence, confidence, communication, sibling rivalry, picky eating, anxiety, independence, raising boys, raising girls, for dads and for moms). Do NOT default to the same scenario every time — think like a real content creator chasing variety and reach.

Write a COHESIVE storyboard for a 90-120 second (1:30 to 2:00) vertical Reel told with STATIC images (one still image per scene, NO animation), featuring the SAME recurring characters in every scene. Structure (proven viral format): HOOK (a scroll-stopping opener addressed to the viewer — a counterintuitive claim, a NAMED method/'trick', or 'the secret to...'; 4-6 FAST scenes) -> call out the common MISTAKE most parents make -> 'here is what actually works' -> 3 practical tips, each with a SPECIFIC thing to SAY or DO (give the exact words, e.g. 'instead of X, say Y'), shown across several real-moment scenes -> a reframe close ('it's not about X, it's about Y') -> a signature tagline. Keep it concrete and direct like a confident expert — NOT a personal story. The visual arc should still feel cohesive and build to a warm payoff.

PACING & COUNT (CRITICAL): Write the COMPLETE narration for a 90-120 second (1:30 to 2:00) video at a warm pace (about 230-300 words total). Break it into SHORT phrases of 6-10 words each (hook even shorter) — ONE image per phrase, so cuts stay fast with zero dead space. The NUMBER of scenes is DETERMINED BY THE SCRIPT: produce as many short-phrase scenes as the narration naturally needs to fill 90-120 seconds (roughly 25-40). Do NOT pad and do NOT force a round number. Hard limit: never more than {{ $('Config').first().json.maxScenes }} scenes.

CRITICAL for visual consistency:
- Define ONE recurring cast that FITS THIS TOPIC — a parent and a child of the appropriate gender and age for the subject (e.g. a dad and his teenage son, a mom and her baby, a father and a school-age daughter, two parents and a tween). Do NOT always use a mother and a toddler; vary the cast to match the topic. Give EXACT, fixed physical detail (age, hairstyle, build, clothing style and shapes) so they look identical in every image. The art is BLACK AND WHITE, so describe shapes and styles only and do NOT mention any colors.
- Define ONE fixed visual style (lighting, palette, lens, mood, setting).
- Each scene's image must visually MATCH that scene's narration and advance the arc.

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no code fences) in EXACTLY this shape:
{
  "title": "<short internal title>",
  "method_name": "<a memorable named technique, or null>",
  "style_guide": "<one rich sentence of fixed visual style>",
  "cast": { "adult": "<exact fixed description of the parent>", "child": "<exact fixed description of the child>" },
  "scenes": [
    { "beat": "<hook|tip1|tip2|tip3|close>", "narration": "<the short, direct advice phrase spoken in this scene (second person, no first-person memoir)>", "on_screen_text": "<short caption, max 6 words>", "image_action": "<what the characters are doing + composition for THIS scene; action, emotion, framing only; leave clear empty space top and bottom for captions>" }
  ],
  "tagline": "<warm signature sign-off line>",
  "fb_caption": "<hooky first line, 1-2 value lines, soft CTA to follow the page>",
  "hashtags": ["<5-8 english parenting hashtags>"]
}
The number of scenes follows the script (one image per short phrase), up to {{ $('Config').first().json.maxScenes }} scenes.

nodes.name: Parse Storyboard
nodes.notes: Validates JSON + builds full_narration. Output is ONE item with the full parsed storyboard.

nodes.name: Split Scenes
nodes.notes: One item per scene. Injects locked style + fixed cast for consistency; sets per-scene duration (2-4s).

nodes.name: Generate Scene Image
nodes.notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, one per scene. Outputs binary 'data'.

nodes.name: Upload Image (unpublished)
nodes.notes: Uploads each scene image to FB unpublished to get a URL for the video + Slack.

nodes.name: Build Movie JSON
nodes.notes: Collects all image URLs + per-scene durations into a JSON2Video movie spec (1080x1920).

nodes.name: Render Video
nodes.notes: POSTs the movie spec to JSON2Video. Returns a project id.

nodes.name: Check Status
nodes.notes: Polls render status. movie.status becomes 'done' with movie.url.

nodes.name: Is Done?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> post the summary. FALSE -> wait and poll again.

nodes.name: Post Summary
nodes.notes: ONE consolidated message: Automation #, Title, Voiceover text + link, Images list, Video link.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [ { parts: [ { text: $('Parse Storyboard').first().json.full_narration } ] } ], generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['AUDIO'], speechConfig: { voiceConfig: { prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName: 'Sulafat' } } } } }) }}

nodes.name: Generate Voiceover
nodes.notes: Gemini TTS (free, reuses your Gemini key). Voice 'Sulafat'. Returns base64 PCM audio.

nodes.name: PCM to WAV
nodes.notes: Wraps Gemini's raw PCM into a playable WAV (binary 'data').

nodes.name: Slack: Upload Voiceover
nodes.notes: Uploads the voiceover WAV to Slack to get a permalink (used in the summary message).

nodes.name: Approve Storyboard
nodes.notes: Posts Title + narration and PAUSES. Approve -> generate images/voiceover/video. Reject -> loop back and write a new storyboard. No paid images until approved.

nodes.name: Storyboard Approved?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> proceed to voiceover + images. FALSE -> loop back to Storyboard Generator to write a new one.
